page.notes: The underlined passage "Ita verum est ... divellere." is marked by a rule in the original and is transcribed in italic only. The bracket beside the second note is a printed reference line, not text. The "moré" in "Regio" line is read with a tilde over the e and may be "more": moré[?]. The text "adiumxit" is printed as such and may be a printing error for "adiunxit". The "s" letters are rendered as s throughout, and the original "Iesu" and "Ioannem" are normalised to Jesu and Joannem as per the i/j rule. The left margin notes are printed in roman type.
